reference_systems.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
reference_systems.gate_translation: clarity, deference, depth, touch-safe controls, and direct task hierarchy

reference_systems.name: Material Design 3 Foundations
reference_systems.gate_translation: deliberate color, typography, motion, layout, and component affordance systems

reference_systems.name: Microsoft Fluent 2
reference_systems.gate_translation: coherent design tokens, elevation, spacing, and interaction states across platforms

reference_systems.name: IBM Carbon Design System
reference_systems.gate_translation: 2x-grid discipline, accessible structure, purposeful density, and production-ready consistency

reference_systems.name: Atlassian Design System
reference_systems.gate_translation: clear product language, predictable navigation, humane density, and resilient component behavior

reference_systems.name: Shopify Polaris
reference_systems.gate_translation: commerce-grade task clarity, action hierarchy, content discipline, and usable empty/loading/error states

reference_systems.name: GOV.UK Service Manual
reference_systems.gate_translation: plain-language service journeys where the next action and user obligation are never ambiguous

reference_systems.name: WCAG 2.2
reference_systems.gate_translation: visible focus, legible contrast, input readability, and touch target discipline

reference_systems.name: Nielsen Norman Group Usability Heuristics
reference_systems.gate_translation: status visibility, recognition over recall, consistency, and clear task feedback

design_principles.standard: Apple HIG clarity plus Nielsen status visibility
design_principles.exit_rule: A new visitor must know what Chummer is, which build to use, and where help lives in one glance.
Typography, color, depth, spacing, and surface rhythm must be named systems, not incidental page styling.
Atmosphere may create depth, but it cannot compete with install, play, status, or recovery decisions.

design_principles.standard: GOV.UK service design plus Shopify action hierarchy
design_principles.exit_rule: Each public route needs one visible job, one primary next action, and supporting choices that do not blur the job.
Contrast, focus, form controls, touch targets, reduced motion, and mobile layout are release criteria, not cleanup.

design_principles.standard: Atlassian content discipline plus HIG clarity
design_principles.exit_rule: Public pages must read like a product, not like a proof harness, provider adapter, internal roadmap, or operator console.

source_design_contract.standard: written exit gate calibrated against named public design systems

premium_palette.standard: Material color roles + Fluent/Carbon semantic tokens

art_direction.standard: HIG deference with purposeful visual depth

interaction_affordance.standard: HIG touch targets + WCAG focus visible + Fluent interaction states

responsive_layout.standard: HIG platform adaptation + Material responsive layout

form_control_legibility.standard: WCAG legibility + HIG direct manipulation for input surfaces

composition_hierarchy.standard: Nielsen consistency + Carbon structure + Fluent depth

component_anatomy.standard: Fluent/Carbon component consistency + HIG direct manipulation

open_chummer_navigation.standard: Nielsen recognition over recall + GOV.UK explicit next action

public_copy_quiet.standard: HIG clarity and Carbon production copy consistency

route_journey_contracts.standard: GOV.UK service journey clarity + Shopify action hierarchy + Nielsen recognition over recall

routes.job: Explain Chummer and make the first install/open action obvious.
Get the user onto the right build without crowding the decision.
required_markers: Sign in later only if you want to attach this installed copy

routes.job: Tell users whether they should install, wait, or ask for help.
Show the participation board as the product surface without extra wrapper noise.
Expose the PWA playtime lane with install, live ledger, continuity, and help actions.

production_basics.standard: accessible production polish before subjective taste
